citationText: Picture taken from Accessed: Jun. 2, 2021. [Online]. Available: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_Network_Management_Protocol#/media/Datei:SNMP_v1.01.pngAn experimental draft version of the IEEE 1588 YANG model is publicly available.31 Currently under development, the SMPTE 2059-15 Recommended Practice is, therefore, defining a YANG data model that encompasses all relevant aspects of time transfer monitoring ranging from the reference clock input such as GNSS, the PTP time transfer itself across different PTP-aware devices to the end node recovering the transmitted time. The results of this work are available to the public via a SMPTE Public Committee Draft (PCD).32 By providing this common definition of the data fields and their respective value ranges, this enables devices collecting those values, either via a pull or a push method, to remove uncertainty in the collected information, and simplify developing monitoring tools that support time transfer capabilities.
